21st-century-fox.name: 21st Century Fox
21st-century-fox.description: Twenty-First Century Fox, Inc., known as 21st Century Fox, was an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate based in New York City. Formed in 2013 as the legal successor to News Corporation, it focused on film and television industries until its acquisition by the Walt Disney Company in 2019. It was the fourth-largest US media conglomerate by revenue before the acquisition.

11-bit-studios.name: 11 Bit Studios
11-bit-studios.description: 11 bit studios S.A. is a Polish video game developer and publisher based in Warsaw. Founded in 2010 by former members of CD Projekt and Metropolis Software, it is known for games such as Anomaly: Warzone Earth, This War of Mine, and Frostpunk.

4licensing-corporation.name: 4Licensing Corporation
4licensing-corporation.description: 4Kids Entertainment, Inc. was an American licensing company specializing in children's entertainment, including English-dubbed Japanese anime. It produced and licensed popular franchises such as Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh! and operated TV program blocks aimed at children.

36kr.name: 36Kr
36kr.description: 36Kr is a publicly listed Chinese media company focusing on technology and financial news. It also provides data services for entrepreneurs and investors.

4ig.name: 4iG
4ig.description: 4iG is a Budapest-based IT company listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange. The name 4iG stands for International, Innovative, IT, and Investment Group. Its predecessor was FreeSoft, an IT-focused company founded in 1990.

37games.name: 37Games
37games.description: 37Games is a Shanghai-registered international developer and publisher of browser and mobile games. It operates across North America, Europe, China, and several Asian countries, with branch offices in multiple Chinese cities. The company went public on China's A-Share stock market in 2014.

2345-com.name: 2345.com
2345-com.description: 2345.com is a Chinese web directory founded in 2005 and hosted by Abitcool China Inc. in Beijing. It is the second most used web directory in China and ranks 47th nationally and 419th worldwide on Alexa. The downloadable version of the site contains adware.

21vianet.name: 21Vianet
21vianet.description: VNET Group, Inc., also known as 21Vianet, is the largest private, carrier-neutral Internet and data center service provider in China. It operates through four domestic companies and is the exclusive operator of Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 services in China. The company also houses data centers for Alibaba and other Chinese firms.

7digital.name: 7digital
7digital.description: 7digital Group PLC is a British company based in London that provides end-to-end music services including access, tracking, and reporting for clients in fitness, social media, DSPs, and gaming industries. It was acquired by Songtradr in 2023 and has produced content for BBC radio stations.

01-communique.name: 01 Communique
01-communique.description: 01 Communique is a Canadian cyber security and technology company headquartered in Mississauga, Ontario. It operates within the software industry.

1-800-flowers.name: 1-800-Flowers
1-800-flowers.description: 1-800-Flowers.com, Inc. is a floral and foods gift retailer and distribution company in the United States. The company focuses on gift baskets outside of Mother's Day and Valentine's Day and also operates under the name 1-800-Baskets.com.

1st-constitution-bancorp.name: 1st Constitution Bancorp
1st-constitution-bancorp.description: 1st Constitution Bancorp was a bank holding company based in Cranbury, New Jersey. It operated 1st Constitution Bank until its acquisition by Lakeland Bancorp, Inc. The company was part of the banking industry.

2u.name: 2U
2u.description: 2U is an American educational technology company that partners with non-profit colleges, universities, and companies to build, deliver, and support online degree and non-degree programs. It is also the parent company of edX.

3d-systems.name: 3D Systems
3d-systems.description: 3D Systems Corporation is an American company based in Rock Hill, South Carolina. It engineers, manufactures, and sells 3D printing materials and application engineering services, creating prototypes, tooling patterns, and production parts using proprietary fabrication processes.

7-days-inn.name: 7 Days Inn
7-days-inn.description: 7 Days Group Holdings Limited, operating as 7 Days Inn, is a Chinese budget hotel chain established in 2005 and based in Guangzhou, Guangdong. It operates in the hospitality sector providing budget accommodations.

10x-genomics.name: 10X Genomics
10x-genomics.description: 10x Genomics, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that designs and manufactures sequencing technologies for scientific research. Its products focus on single-cell and spatial omics development.

5n-plus-inc.name: 5N Plus Inc.
5n-plus-inc.description: 5N Plus is a Canadian producer of high-purity metals and compounds for electronic applications, including cadmium telluride supplied to First Solar. Founded in 2000, it is headquartered in Saint-Laurent, Quebec, Canada. The company serves customers worldwide with operations in North America, Europe, and Asia.

1st-source.name: 1st Source
1st-source.description: 1st Source Corporation is a financial services company headquartered in South Bend, Indiana. It operates 1st Source Bank with branches in Indiana and Michigan and provides financing for aircraft, trucks, and construction equipment, as well as insurance products through 1st Source Insurance.

24-horas.name: 24 Horas
24-horas.hq: Edificio Corporativo de Televisión Nacional de Chile, Chile
24-horas.city: Edificio Corporativo de Televisión Nacional de Chile
24-horas.description: 24 horas is the news brand of the Chilean public broadcaster Televisión Nacional de Chile. It began as a news program in 1990 and became a television channel called Canal 24 horas in 2009.

4-72.description: Servicios Postales Nacionales operates Colombia's official postal service under the name 4-72. It took over operations from the liquidated Adpostal in 2006 and provides national and international mail, express courier, and postal payment services. The company is associated with the Ministry of Information Technologies and Communications.
